a
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
-o out.txt a
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[out.txt] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
-oout.txt a
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[out.txt] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
--output out.txt a
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[out.txt] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
--output=out.txt a
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[out.txt] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
--output= a
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
-vqv a
  verbose=2 quiet=1 output=[] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
-v --verbose a -vv
  verbose=4 quiet=0 output=[] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
-vn5 a
  verbose=1 quiet=0 output=[] lines=5 shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
-qn 7 a
  verbose=0 quiet=1 output=[] lines=7 shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
-s -3 a
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[] lines=10(default) shift=-3 ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
--shift=4 --ratio 0.25 -l naïve --lines=0 a
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[] lines=0 shift=4 ratio=0.25 label=naïve include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
-I x --include=y -Iz a
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[x,y,z] FILE=[a] MORE=[]
a b -v c
  verbose=1 quiet=0 output=[] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[a] MORE=[b,c]
-v -- -a --b --
  verbose=1 quiet=0 output=[] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[-a] MORE=[--b,--]
- -
  verbose=0 quiet=0 output=[] lines=10(default) shift=none ratio=none label=none include=[] FILE=[-] MORE=[-]
